title: Colophon Declaration
description: Operator-authored statement of what one agent may do. Unsigned intent. Becomes a Record via `colophon record build`.

id.description: UUID v4. The all-zero UUID is rejected.

owner.description: Accountable human or team, e.g. an email at the operator's domain.

autonomy_level.description: CSA-style autonomy level. L0: no autonomy, human performs every action. L1: assistive, proposes and a human acts. L2: supervised, acts only on per-action human approval. L3: delegated, acts within declared bounds with a human on the loop. L4: bounded autonomous, acts inside hard constraints, humans engage on exception only. L5: fully autonomous, broad discretion.

data_classes.description: Data classes this tool may touch. Must be a subset of the top-level data_classes.

destinations.description: For tools that send or fetch: allowed destination patterns (glob on address, host, or URL prefix).

data_classes.description: Every data class the agent may touch across all tools, e.g. public, internal, confidential, pii, secret.

write_paths.description: Path prefixes the agent may write under. Any write outside is refused.

max_scopes.description: Upper bound on credential scopes any auth.* tool may request.

review_due.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A Record past this date is stale and fails lint.

a2a_card_uri.description: Optional citation of an A2A Agent Card. Identity only; never a permission source.

defaults.description: Labels a Colophon PEP applies when the caller states none. The Decision records that the label came from here, so the packet never presents an operator default as the agent's own statement.

data_class.description: Applied to a call that carries no data_class (Claude Code tools never label). Must be one of the top-level data_classes.

pep.description: Optional foreign PEP binding on the signed Record. When the PEP is AgentCore Gateway + Dogwood, name the MCP tool schema, the Dogwood policy set (id + version/hash), the Gateway id if known, and ENFORCE vs LOG_ONLY. Colophon does not reimplement that policy; this is the declared allow/deny boundary the packet is evidence of.

kind.description: Foreign PEP name. Use agentcore-dogwood for AgentCore Gateway + Dogwood. Not aws-config (CloudTrail/IAM is a separate adapter).

enforcement_mode.description: ENFORCE: the Gateway applies allow/deny. LOG_ONLY: Dogwood evaluates and Colophon records the would-be decision; the Gateway does not block.

tool_schema_ref.description: Agent/MCP tool schema reference (URI or repo-relative path). What tools were declared.

policy_set_hash.description: SHA-256 of the Dogwood/Cedar policy set bytes the Gateway evaluated.

gateway_id.description: AgentCore Gateway id or ARN, if known.

tool_name_prefix.description: Prefix the foreign PEP puts on tool names as recorded (AgentCore Gateway: `<TargetName>___`). COL-05 strips it before re-evaluating an executed call against the declared tools. A naming map, not a policy.
